meta.description: Capture any public URL into a RSS feed that you can read from your favorite reader.

how_it_works.title: How rsstodolist works
how_it_works.description: Send us a URL and a feed name. We turn it into an RSS item so you can triage articles, docs, and inspiration directly where you already read news.
features: Minimal setup — no registration, just pick a feed name.
Bring your own client — every feed is compatible with RSS/Atom readers.
Privacy friendly — self-host that Open Source service.

public_instance.title: About this public instance
warnings: This hosted version is « open » : anyone who knows your feed name can read, add, or remove entries.
It also runs on a hobby Fly.io plan, so uptime and quotas are limited.
public_instance.self_host: For more reliability and privacy, please consider self host rsstodolist
